The primary goal shifted from "development" to "survival." Reviewed sales and expenses since my father fell ill, confirming that cash flow constraints are the biggest issue. Drafted a detailed response plan point by point: 1. Shorten business hours to 1:00 PM to 7:00 PM; 2. Explore online transformation, strengthen WeChat customer group operations, and experiment with a "VIP appointment system" and weekly themed live-streaming clearance sales; 3. Seek potential collaborations, listing friends who might be interested in investment or partnership (such as Zhang Wei and cousin Shen Jie) for future communication; 4. Implement extreme cost-cutting measures by reviewing all non-essential expenses. The entire process was focused and dedicated, transforming scattered thoughts into clear action items.

The conversation naturally transitioned from career topics to life matters. You earnestly discussed the possibility of building a life together, including whether to live with your parents, the timeline and budget for relocating, how to set joint savings goals, and managing daily expenses. This dialogue lasted over three hours, marking a substantial leap in your relationship from "enjoyable dates" to "life partners capable of facing reality and planning the future together."

I’d like to meet with you to discuss the mall’s overall activities for next month and how our store can coordinate. How about meeting at the Starbucks we often go to (on the first floor of the mall)? Along the way, stop at "Jiang You Ji" to taste beef potstickers and osmanthus-fermented glutinous rice. Lei Mingxuan uses his phone to capture storefronts, window displays, and spatial utilization methods, gathering commercial inspiration.
location: Lao Men Dong Historical and Cultural Block, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province (Main Entrance: Gutong Lane)

name: A brief rest and heading to the dinner venue.
description: I took a short break at a tea house in Laomendong, sipping on Yuhua tea. Then, following the navigation, I walked for about 15 minutes to the dinner restaurant I had reserved. Along the way, I passed by the Zhonghuamen City Wall, where I stopped to take photos and admire the magnificent scenery under the setting sun.
location: Old East Gate Street, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province

name: Couple's Dinner Under the Night View of the Qinhuai River
description: Enjoying a romantic dinner at Jinling Menghua Palace Banquet Restaurant, the classical ambiance offers a window-side view of the gradually lit lanterns along the Qinhuai River. The menu features refined and reinvented Jinling dishes, such as Rain Flower Stone Glutinous Rice Balls (shrimp filling), Wensi Tofu Soup, and Jinling Double Stinky Delicacies (innovative version). Over the meal, the two discussed their discoveries from the day’s exploration—Lei Mingxuan shared his inspirations for spatial design, while Lin Wei talked about the charm of cultural and creative products. Setting aside work worries for a while, they immersed themselves in their own world.
location: Qinhuai District (Laomendong Area), Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, Jinling Menghua Palace Banquet (Nanjing Laomendong Branch)

name: Night Tour of the Qinhuai River and a Stroll to Aid Digestion
description: After dinner, we strolled into the night scenery of the Qinhuai River, walking along the riverbank from Wende Bridge to the Dongshuiguan section. Painted boats glided over the waves, and the lights were dazzling; hand in hand, we watched the bustling crowds of tourists at Wende Bridge and felt the serene history at the Dongshuiguan Ruins Park. Lei Mingxuan bought a glowing rabbit lantern for Lin Wei, and the two played like children, adding a touch of romantic charm.
location: Jiangsu Province, Nanjing City, Qinhuai District, Qinhuai River Scenic Belt of Confucius Temple, along the riverbank from Wende Bridge to Dongshuiguan Section

name: A Casual Drink at a Quiet Bar and Deep Conversation
description: A 10-minute taxi ride takes you to the hidden speakeasy-style bar "Magpie Bar." With its discreet entrance and retro interior, the two sit at the counter and order "Nanjing Wutong" (a gin-based drink with tea notes) and "Rouge" (a non-alcoholic option). Amidst the mellow ambiance and blues music, the conversation shifts from travel anecdotes to discussions about life and career plans, including ideas for launching a pop-up store in Hangzhou and the possibility of building a future together, fostering a meaningful emotional connection.
location: No. 12, Dasi Fu Lane, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, Magpie Bar

name: Return to the hotel
description: It takes about 15 minutes by taxi from the bar to return to Nanjing Jinling Zhuangyuanlou Hotel. The streets of Nanjing are quiet at night, marking the end of a day's outing.
location: No. 9 Zhuangyuanjing, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, Nanjing Jinling Zhuangyuanlou Hotel

name: Organize records, plan for tomorrow, and rest.
description: After returning to the hotel room and freshening up, Lei Mingxuan synchronized the photos taken that day and the inspiration keywords to his cloud notes, organizing them into categories. He discussed the next day's arrangements with Lin Wei: in the morning, they would visit the Changjiang Road Historical and Cultural District (near the Presidential Palace and the Jiangning Weaving Museum), and in the afternoon, depending on the situation, they would check out the Wutaishan flagship store of the Pioneer Bookstore. Before going to bed, he sent WeChat messages to his parents and his cousin Shen Jie to let them know he was safe and to inquire about the situation at the shop. After receiving a reply saying "everything is fine," he fell asleep peacefully, feeling both satisfied and exhausted.
location: Room, Nanjing Jinling Zhuangyuanlou Hotel, No. 9 Zhuangyuanjing, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Morning Wake-up and Work Check
description: Woken up by the alarm clock in the guest room of Jinling Zhuangyuanlou Hotel in Nanjing, I felt I had slept more soundly than at home. After waking, I first lay in bed and checked the summary of yesterday’s online orders from the shop, sent by the clerk Xiao Liu, confirming everything was normal, and replied to a regular customer’s overnight inquiry about sizing. I then got up and did some simple stretches to relieve the leg muscles strained from yesterday’s intense walking. While washing up, I smiled at myself in the mirror and began planning out the tight schedule for the morning.
location: No. 9 Zhuangyuanjing, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, Nanjing Jinling Zhuangyuanlou Hotel, Inside the Guest Room

name: Visit emerging community cafes in Nanjing for inspiration.
description: To make efficient use of time, I walked about 15 minutes to the boutique café 'Yue She,' located in a renovated old neighborhood not far from the hotel. I ordered a pour-over coffee and, while savoring it, carefully observed how the space was utilized—such as how the narrow, elongated old house was made more open and airy through a courtyard and glass curtain walls, as well as the pairing of furniture selection with greenery displays. After a brief conversation with the young owner, I learned that they often collaborate with local independent designers to host small pop-up events. Inspired by the experience, I took photos of many details with my phone and noted down keywords like "community cohesion" and "pop-up collaborations" to gather inspiration for store operations.
location: Near Diyutai in Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, the 'Yue She' community café

name: Having brunch with my girlfriend while simultaneously organizing our inspiration for exploring new spots.
description: After meeting up with my girlfriend Lin Wei at the hotel, we took a taxi to Nanjing Impressions in the Shuipingfang Mall for brunch. While waiting for a table and during the meal, I eagerly shared my recent experiences and photos from 'Yue She.' The two of us systematically reviewed the discoveries we made during our visits to various shops yesterday and this morning. Lei Mingxuan organized the photos on his phone, while Lin Wei used her memo app to jot down points worth referencing, including 'Yue She's' community operation strategy and the layout design of a particular store. This essentially completed the core process of 'organizing insights and inspirations from our visits.' We tentatively agreed that, upon returning to Shanghai, we would prioritize creating a 'monthly themed pop-up corner' in a corner of our shop.
location: 5th Floor, Shuipingfang Shopping Mall, Jiankang Road, Qinhuai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, Nanjing Impressions (Shuipingfang Branch)

description: Return to the hotel to check out and collect luggage, then take a ride-hailing service (approximately 25 minutes) to Nanjing South Railway Station. On the way, post a message in the "City Pulse Enthusiasts" community to interact with regular customers. Upon arriving at the station, with nearly 50 minutes before departure, the two purchase water and snacks at a convenience store inside. Lei Mingxuan finds a seat and quickly inputs the key points discussed in the morning into his phone notes, creating a clear "Nanjing Inspiration Action List." Meanwhile, Lin Wei selects two boxes of exquisite Nanjing tea snacks to bring back to Shanghai as gifts for Lei Mingxuan’s parents.
location: No. 98 Yulan Road, Yuhuatai District, Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province, Nanjing South Railway Station, Waiting Hall

In the latter half, travel fatigue set in. Lei Mingxuan put on headphones to listen to light music and browsed through his phone's photo album, reminiscing about the short yet fulfilling trip with a sense of satisfaction. Lin Wei leaned against him for a nap. The train ran on schedule, smoothly completing the return journey to Shanghai.
location: Gxxx High-speed Train Carriage (Nanjing South -> Shanghai Hongqiao)

name: Arriving at Shanghai Hongqiao Station and the journey home alone.
description: The train arrived at Shanghai Hongqiao Station. After parting ways with his girlfriend Lin Wei at the subway station (she took Line 2 back to Puxi), Lei Mingxuan took Line 2 alone to Century Avenue Station, transferred to Line 4, and got off at Pudong Avenue Station. From there, he walked for about 8 minutes to return home in Shanggang Community, with a total commute time of approximately 50 minutes. On the subway, he sent a voice message to Zhou Tao, a supplier in Hangzhou, discussing an interesting fabric application he had seen in Nanjing and arranging a meeting next week to talk about the new July collection.
location: No. 1500, Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, from Shanghai Hongqiao Station to No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area

I retrieved the meal my mother had set aside for me (sweet and sour pork ribs and stir-fried spinach) from the refrigerator, heated it up, and had a late lunch. While eating, I video-called my mother to let her know I was safe and showed her the Nanjing tea snacks Lin Wei had picked out. My mother reminded me that there was soup simmering at home for the evening and advised me to be careful while exercising.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area, at home

name: Prepare the roller skating equipment and head to the Binjiang Roller Skating Track.
description: After resting at home for a while after the meal, I carefully checked the wheels and brakes of my inline skates and put on protective gear such as knee pads and wrist guards. Considering my old ankle injury and travel fatigue, I decided to focus on relaxed skating today and planned a route starting from the riverside inline skating track near the Decathlon Badminton Hall, heading toward the Yangpu Bridge for about 4 kilometers before turning back. Afterward, I packed my gear, walked to the bus stop, and took the Pudong No. 4 bus (approximately a 25-minute ride) to Langu Road Station. From there, it was a 3-minute walk to the familiar entrance of the skating track.
location: From Building 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area to the entrance of the Riverside Roller Skating Track beside the Decathlon Badminton Hall, Lan Gu Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Riverside Roller Skating: Solitude and Reflections on Work and Life
description: After a thorough warm-up on the riverside rollerblading track in Pudong, I began to skate. The evening breeze along the river in early summer carried a hint of moisture, feeling refreshing against my face. Maintaining a steady pace, my body gradually relaxed, and my thoughts drifted away. Amidst the river breeze, I reviewed the closing performance of the shop in June and focused on planning for July: first, confirming the details of the pop-up store inspection in Hangzhou with my partner Qin Lang; second, prioritizing the "Nanjing Inspiration Action List" and selecting the two most cost-effective and visually impactful items for minor shop renovations; third, reminding myself to schedule a follow-up appointment for my ankle next week. Upon reaching the turning point, I took a deep breath facing the expansive river, feeling exceptionally clear-headed. The return journey was more leisurely, allowing me to savor the sense of mental release brought by exercise. The total skating distance was approximately 8 kilometers.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Pudong Riverside Roller Skating Track (from Lan Gu Road to Qichangzhan Ferry Turnaround Section)

After changing back into casual shoes, I took the Pudong Bus No. 4 back to Shanggang Community. Upon arriving home, I immediately took a shower to wash away the sweat and fatigue. After changing into clean home clothes, I went to the dining room to have dinner with my parents. My mother prepared a hearty dinner, including a rich and fragrant chicken soup. As we ate, the family chatted, and Lei Mingxuan shared more about his experiences in Nanjing. Old Lei listened with great interest and reminded him that while business inspiration is important, it must be implemented steadily and solidly.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area, at home

I then quickly handled the daily operational data from the shop's backend. Following that, I posted a few photos of Nanjing's street scenes and local delicacies that did not involve any trade secrets in the "City Pulse Enthusiasts" community, thanking the group members for their attention and maintaining the community's vibrancy. After completing these tasks, the noticeable fatigue from the trip washed over me once again.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area, Home Study

location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area, Home

Leaning against the headboard, I intended to browse some trendy toy updates, but my eyelids grew heavy. Before 22:00, I turned off the lights and lay down, falling into a deep sleep almost as soon as my head touched the pillow. This marked the end of an exhausting weekend and allowed me to recharge for the upcoming week of work and life.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Area, Bedroom at Home

location: At home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

Ji Hotel (Hangzhou Huanglong Wensan Road Branch)

name: The store is closed and the UPS equipment is being tested.

Critical test: simulating a power outage. He took a deep breath and unplugged the main plug from the wall. Instantly, the screens of the cash register computer and the surveillance monitor only flickered slightly without going black. The UPS emitted a continuous "beep" sound, with the indicator light showing that it was running on battery power. After waiting for about two minutes, the equipment remained stable. He plugged the main power back in, and the UPS switched back to charging mode from the mains, with the alarm deactivated. The test was successful! Satisfied, he patted this "safe box," having resolved his worries. Finally, he settled the day's sales revenue.

Around 11:30, they decide to exit the highway in Wuxing District, Huzhou, for lunch, and find a well-reviewed "1517 Home-style Restaurant" using their phones.

name: Have lunch in Huzhou.
description: After exiting the highway, we found the 1517 Family Restaurant using navigation. The restaurant was quite busy, and we ordered three dishes and a soup, all with a homely taste. Lei Mingxuan restrained himself by ordering only a small bowl of rice. After the meal, we sat in the restaurant for a short rest.

name: Drive to Moganshan and arrive at the booked homestay.
description: After lunch, we continued driving, turning from Provincial Highway 304 onto the Moganshan Tourist Route. The winding mountain road led us upward, flanked by dense bamboo forests, and the air grew increasingly fresh. About an hour later, we arrived at the pre-booked "Moganshan Tea Language Homestay." The homestay is an exquisite building with a tea culture theme.
location: No. 583, Fenghuang Road, Wuxing District, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, 1517 Family Restaurant

name: Check-in and Room Settling
description: At the homestay's front desk, they quickly completed the check-in process, where the staff warmly introduced the facilities (tea room, viewing platform) and offered suggestions for nearby attractions. After receiving the room key, the two checked into a room with a scenic view. Opening the window, they were greeted by lush greenery and distant, layered mountains. They quickly unpacked their luggage and changed into more comfortable and casual shoes and clothing.
location: Moganshan Yucha Homestay, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Front Desk and Guest Rooms

name: Leisurely Rest Time at the Homestay
description: They were not in a hurry to go out. The two of them first took a short rest in the room, then went to the public viewing deck of the homestay and sat down. Lei Mingxuan used the tea set in the room to brew the local green tea provided by the homestay. With the mountain breeze and sunlight, they simply relaxed, chatted, and took photos. Completely detached from the hustle and bustle of the city, Lei Mingxuan felt a long-lost sense of relaxation.
location: Mogan Mountain Tea Language Homestay, Mogan Mountain Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, guest rooms and public viewing areas.

name: A Light Hike Through the Mountain Bamboo Forest
description: Following the recommendation of the homestay staff, the two set out from the back door of the homestay and embarked on a hike along a clear stone-paved trail. The path wound through a dense bamboo forest, accompanied by the gentle murmur of a flowing stream. Sunlight filtered through the bamboo leaves, casting dappled shadows on the ground. Lei Mingxuan made a conscious effort to moderate his pace, opting for a gentle hike instead of his usual intense workouts. They walked leisurely, pausing occasionally to breathe in the fresh air and capture the scenery with their phones. After about an hour and a half of hiking, they retraced their steps back to the homestay.
location: Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Deqing County, Moganshan Town, from the back door of the Moganshan Yu Tea Homestay to the nearby hiking trail by the bamboo forest stream.

name: Return to the homestay to wash up and change clothes.
description: After the hike, there was a light sheen of sweat on their bodies. They took turns washing up, changed into clean clothes, and began preparing for dinner.
location: Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Deqing County, Moganshan Town, Moganshan Tea Homestay, Guest Room

name: Drive to the farmhouse for dinner.
description: According to the homestay recommendation, drive to "Moganshan Greenfield Farmhouse" about 5 kilometers away. Exercise caution when driving on mountain roads at night; the journey takes approximately 15 minutes.
location: Moganshan Yucha Homestay, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Farmhouse Dinner
description: The restaurant had a distinct rustic charm and was bustling with customers. The two ordered local Mogan Mountain specialties: braised pork with dried bamboo shoots, stir-fried wild vegetables, and free-range chicken soup. As a fan of local cuisine, Lei Mingxuan couldn't stop praising the braised pork with dried bamboo shoots. Although he reminded himself to exercise restraint, he ended up eating a few more bites than usual without even realizing it, and also drank two bowls of the chicken soup. Lin Wei teased him, saying he had "shown his true colors."
location: Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Mogan Mountain Greenfield Farm (Gaonan Branch)

name: Return to the homestay.
description: After dinner, we drove back along the same road to the guesthouse. The mountain night was cool and tranquil, with the car lights illuminating the winding path.
location: Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Mogan Mountain Green Field Farm (Gaonan Branch)

name: Nighttime Chat at the Homestay
description: Returning to the guesthouse, the two of them made their way back to the viewing platform (or the room's balcony). Lei Mingxuan boiled water and brewed the black tea they had brought along. The night sky over the mountains was clear, revealing a multitude of stars. In a state of complete relaxation, their conversation delved deeper than usual. They shared their recent life experiences (Lei Mingxuan talked about the progress of his shop and his family's plans to move to a new house, while Lin Wei discussed her work), envisioned future travel plans (mentioning their already planned road trip to western Sichuan), and touched upon more personal and emotional topics. It was their first night staying together away from home, and amidst the embrace of nature, their relationship quietly grew warmer, with a noticeable increase in mutual understanding and intimacy.
location: Mogan Mountain Tea Language Homestay, Mogan Mountain Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Guest Room or Viewing Platform

name: Washing Up and Pre-Sleep Relaxation
description: After their nighttime conversation, both felt content yet somewhat weary. They took turns washing up, then leaned against the headboard and scrolled through their phones for a while. Lei Mingxuan saw a message from his mother, saying she and his father had looked at two apartments today and felt good about them, agreeing to discuss it in more detail tomorrow. He replied briefly and set an alarm for the next morning.
location: Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Deqing County, Moganshan Town, Moganshan Tea Homestay, Guest Room

name: Go to bed
description: Amid the tranquility of the mountains and the occasional chirping of insects, the two fell asleep one after another, concluding a fulfilling, relaxing day that brought their relationship a step closer.
location: Moganshan Yucha Homestay, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Guest Room

name: Morning Stroll and Check-out at Mogan Mountain
description: Take a stroll along the bamboo forest path near Moganshan Tea Homestay, breathing in the fresh mountain air, then return to the homestay for a healthy breakfast (plain porridge, boiled eggs, and local dried bamboo shoot side dishes). Afterwards, pack your luggage and check out, bidding a simple farewell to the homestay owner.
location: Mogan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, Yucha Homestay and the surrounding bamboo forest trails.

Lin Wei waited in the car.

His mother, Wang Xiuying, expressed concerns about elevator maintenance in high-rise buildings and the details of property management fees. Both parents believed that the search should lean toward areas with good greenery and mature communities around Century Park. Lei Mingxuan took notes on their opinions, preparing to relay the feedback to the agent.

I also cleaned the DSLR lens with a lens pen.

He secretly took a few photos with his phone of outfits he found inspiring. After that, he strolled back to his own shop from the UR store, enjoying the afternoon sunshine and thinking about who to invite for a game of basketball in the evening.
location: No. LG1-013, Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, URBAN REVIVO Shanghai Century Link Mall Store

name: Afternoon Store Operations and Communication
description: There were relatively fewer customers in the afternoon. Lei Mingxuan used this time to handle online matters: he responded to customer inquiries on his Taobao store and posted a set of nine-square-grid photos of new autumn outfits on his social media feed (caption: "Autumn is here, have you updated your wardrobe?"). Zheng Kai (Brother Kai), the mall property manager, came by for a routine inspection, and the two discussed possible promotional arrangements for the National Day holiday at the mall. Lei Mingxuan also sent a message to his cousin Shen Jie (Jiejie), inviting her to come to the store over the weekend when she had time to help with selecting styles for the next batch of stock.
location: Shanghai City, Pudong New Area, Hangtou Town, Personal Clothing Store inside Hangtou Shichen Shopping Mall

name: Shop Closing and Account Reconciliation
description: As the mall approached closing time, Lei Mingxuan began wrapping up his tasks: he tidied the displayed clothes back into place and swept the floor. Finally, he used the cash register system to check the day's turnover and recorded the accounts. With a good sales performance for the day, he was in high spirits.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Hangtou Town, Hangtou Shichen Shopping Mall, Personal Clothing Store

name: Dinner
description: After closing the shop, Lei Mingxuan felt a bit hungry and didn’t want to eat at home. He decided to have dinner at Hefu Noodles in the nearby Xinmei Plaza, as it was a flavor he enjoyed. He ordered a signature sour soup beef noodle with a soft-boiled egg added, and ate with great satisfaction. While eating, he asked Zhang Wei and Li Na in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group what they were doing that evening.
location: Room 109, 1st Floor Shopping Mall, No. 999 Pudong South Road, China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone, Hefu Noodles (Shanghai Xinmei Plaza Branch)

name: Commuting to the billiards hall.
description: Zhang Wei replied that he was free in the evening and suggested playing pool. Lei Mingxuan immediately called to book their usual spot at Qiao's Star Billiards Hall and invited another pool buddy, Han Dong (Dongzi). After finishing his noodles, he drove to the billiards hall.
location: 3rd Floor, Building B, Pulehui, No. 500 Chengshan Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Qiao's Star Billiards and Chess Club (Chengshan Road Branch)

name: Billiards Social Activity
description: I met up with my friends Zhang Wei and Han Dong at the pool hall. The three of us played American eight-ball. Lei Mingxuan was in great form today, winning several games in a row, which put him in a fantastic mood. As they played, they chatted about recent funny stories and work-related frustrations (mainly Zhang Wei complaining about his boss). This was one of Lei Mingxuan’s most relaxing social moments of the week.
location: No. 500 Chengshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, 3rd Floor, Building B, Pulehui, Qiao's Star Billiards and Chess Club (Chengshan Road Branch)

name: Commuting back home
description: After playing ball, I said goodbye to my friends. Lei Mingxuan drove home alone. The roads were clear at night, and as he listened to soothing music, he reminisced about the good business of the day and the joy of winning the game.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, in the home at Shanggang Residential Area.

name: Evening washing, calling, leisure, and going to bed.
description: Upon arriving home, his parents had already gone to bed. He washed up quietly, then lay down in bed and made a video call to his girlfriend Lin Wei in Hangzhou, sharing the day’s store performance and his “victory” from winning the basketball game that evening. Lin Wei laughed and teased him for “showing off.” After the call, he scrolled through short videos for a while and watched an episode of the latest anime update. He set the alarm for the next day (07:00), checked his phone to confirm there were no unread important work messages, and sent a message in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat saying, "Going to sleep, back to work tomorrow." Zhang Wei replied with a "Goodnight" emoji. He turned off the lights and went to bed, ending a fulfilling day.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, in the bedroom of the Shanggang Residential Community home.

name: Wake up, wash up, and have breakfast.
date: From 08:15:00 on September 18, 2025, to 09:00:00 on September 18, 2025
description: Waking up in the clear morning light of the plateau, I felt well-rested from the night before, with the slight headache completely gone. I immediately asked about the condition of my companion Zhao Min, who said she had mostly recovered but still felt a bit weak. Everyone was in good spirits. We had a simple Tibetan-style breakfast (porridge, steamed buns, eggs, and butter tea) at the hotel restaurant, storing up energy for the day's journey.
location: A hotel room and restaurant in Xinduqiao Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

name: Drive to Tagong Grassland.
description: After checking out, we drove the rented SUV from Xinduqiao Town, and I took on most of the driving tasks. The scenery outside the window gradually shifted from pastoral landscapes to vast plateau meadows. The weather was clear, with excellent visibility, and the distant Yala Snow Mountain was clearly visible. Inside the car, a relaxing travel playlist was playing, and everyone was in high spirits.
location: On the road from the hotel in Xinduqiao Town, turning from National Highway G318 to Provincial Highway S434 towards Tagong Grassland.

name: Visit Tagong Grassland and Photography
description: Park the car near the viewing platform of Tagong Grassland, facing the vast golden grassland and the majestic, sacred Yala Snow Mountain, feeling a sense of openness. Immediately take out the DSLR and drone to start creating, actively taking on the role of "team photographer," guiding Zhang Wei and Zhao Min to pose for creative portraits. Zhao Min's condition improves, and she excitedly requests more photos. Stroll and sit quietly on the grassland, fully immersing in the tranquility and grandeur.
location: Tagong Grassland, Tagong Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province (near the Yala Snow Mountain Viewing Platform)

name: Lunch in Tagong Town
description: We found a clean and busy restaurant in Tagong Town for lunch, ordering yak meat, green vegetables, and noodle soup. As we ate, we reminisced about the beautiful scenery from the morning and discussed the photos we had taken. The practical side of us came out, reminding everyone that we still had a walk ahead to the Mosi Stone Forest Park in the afternoon, so we should eat more to store up energy.
location: A Tibetan/ Sichuan Cuisine Restaurant in Tagong Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Drive to the Inkstone Park.
description: After a brief rest, continue driving the SUV to the Inkstone Park. The journey is not far, and the road conditions are good, preparing for the afternoon's exploration.
location: On the road from Tagong Town to the Moshishan Park scenic area in Bamei Town, Daofu County

name: Explore the Geological Wonders of Moshishan Park
description: Entering the Mosi Stone Park, known as the "Alien Planet," I wandered among the peculiar black-gray stone forests and earth forests, marveling at the breathtaking geological landscapes crafted by nature. As someone who enjoys novelty and excitement, this unique experience was truly thrilling. I continuously shifted angles, using my camera to capture the lines, light, shadows, and textures of the stone forests, attempting to convey their desolate and mysterious beauty. I also snapped some fun moments of Zhang Wei and Zhao Min exploring among the stone formations and hiked along the park’s main scenic trails.
location: Within the Moshishan Park Scenic Area, Zhonggu Village, Bamei Town, Daofu County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Drive to the guesthouse in Tagong Town.
description: After finishing the tour of the Inkstone Park, we drove back to Tagong Town. We chose to stay overnight in Tagong Town to have more flexibility for traveling to Danba or returning to Xinduqiao tomorrow.
location: On the way back from the Ink Stone Park to the pre-booked homestay in Tagong Town.

name: Handling Check-in and Rest at the Homestay
description: We checked into the pre-booked Tibetan-style homestay, where the room decor was quite distinctive. After everyone settled into their assigned rooms, we freshened up a bit to ease the fatigue from the hike. My outgoing nature prompted me to wander around the common area, where I had a brief chat with the homestay owner.
location: A Tibetan-style homestay room and public areas in Tagong Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

name: Dinner and Traveler Socializing
description: Enjoy dinner at a homestay or a restaurant in town, where the dishes are mainly Sichuan cuisine and Tibetan food. After the meal, return to the cozy common area of the homestay, where several travelers from all over the country have gathered. Naturally join the conversation, sharing today's experiences at Tagong Grassland and Mosi Park, and listen to others' recommended routes and interesting stories. This casual social interaction brings a sense of joy.
location: Homestay restaurant or restaurants near Tagong Town, public areas of homestays

name: Organize photos and have casual chats within the team.
description: Return to the room or stay in the common area, use a laptop to export some of today's best photos, and review them together with Zhang Wei and Zhao Min, offering mutual feedback. Everyone discusses the itinerary choices for tomorrow—whether to go to a closer hiking spot at the foot of Yala Snow Mountain or head directly to Danba to see the watchtowers and Tibetan villages—in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: A Tibetan-style homestay room/public area in Tagong Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Wei.
date: From 21:30:00 on September 18, 2025, to 22:30:00 on September 18, 2025
description: Back in my room, I connected to the Wi-Fi (the signal on the plateau might be a bit unstable) and initiated a video call with my girlfriend Lin Wei in Shanghai. I excitedly shared today's journey: the awe-inspiring beauty of Yala Snow Mountain, the unique landscapes of Mosi Park, and the joy of everyone after Zhao Min recovered her health. I showed her a few carefully selected photos. Lin Wei listened intently, happy that I was having a good time, while also reminding me to stay safe on the plateau and not to overexert myself. We chatted for nearly an hour, and our bond grew stronger through the sharing.
location: A Tibetan-style homestay room in Tagong Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

name: Relaxation before sleep and bedtime.
description: After finishing the video call, I went to bed a bit later than usual. I scrolled through my phone for a while, checked social media, and reviewed the route guide for tomorrow. I felt a bit physically tired (after all, I had hiked and sightseen for about 3 hours at high altitude), but my heart was filled with joy and a sense of fulfillment. Around 11:45 PM, I fell asleep with satisfaction from the beautiful scenery of the day and a slight drowsiness.
location: A Tibetan-style homestay room in Tagong Town, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Morning Preparation and Health Management
date: From 08:30:00 on September 19, 2025 to 09:30:00 on September 19, 2025
description: Waking up in the room of the Dongzanling Boutique Homestay in Tagong Town, the highland sunlight filters through the curtains. I perform shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to prepare for the long drive ahead, while checking my phone messages to confirm there are no urgent matters in the Shanghai store’s work group, allowing me to travel with peace of mind. After a quick wash and organizing my luggage, ensuring items like chargers and camera batteries are not forgotten, I run into my companion Zhang Wei in the hallway and greet him.
location: Wencheng Road, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Dongzanling Boutique Homestay Rooms and Corridor, Tagong Town

name: Homestay Breakfast and Departure Preparation
description: Enjoying a breakfast of porridge, steamed rolls, pickles, and butter tea at the homestay restaurant, I met up with my companions Zhang Wei and Zhao Min for a chat. Zhao Min was in better spirits and shared her experience of stargazing the previous night, reminding everyone to check their luggage, water, and snacks. The homestay staff warmly refilled our tea. After quickly completing the checkout process and taking a group photo with the owner, we inspected the tires and fuel level of the rented SUV, loaded the vehicle, and set the navigation destination to Jiaju Tibetan Village in Danba County. At 10:10, we drove away from the homestay, bidding farewell to Tagong Town.
location: Wencheng Road, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Dongzanling Boutique Homestay Restaurant and Entrance Parking Lot, Tagong Town

name: Driving to appreciate the plateau valley scenery.
description: As the primary driver, I focused on navigating the SUV along National Highway G248 from Tagong Town to Danba County. Outside the window, the scenery transitioned from the grasslands of Tagong to the hilly terrain of Bamei, under bright sunshine, with relaxing music playing inside the car. My companion, Zhang Wei, was responsible for observing road conditions and taking photos. As we chatted, we compared life in Shanghai with the vast emptiness of western Sichuan, remarking that this place was suitable for retirement but not for opening a shop—a reflection of his business-minded perspective.
location: G248 National Highway (Tagong to Bamei Section), Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Rest stops and simple lunches during the journey
description: We stopped at the viewing platform along National Highway G248 to take a break, stretch our legs, and take wide-angle photos of the road and valley. Zhao Min took a group photo for everyone. Later, at a simple rest area, we had lunch with our own bread, ham, fruit, and bottled water. We joked that we’d make up for the simple lunch with a better dinner, and that our health control plan needed some adjustments.
location: Observation Deck and Rest Area along National Highway G248, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Driving through the Dadu River Gorge
description: Continuing to drive deeper into the tributary canyon of the Dadu River, the mountains are steep, requiring careful navigation through continuous curves. The scenery is majestic and perilous, with glimpses of Tibetan villages and watchtowers on the mountainsides. My companions and I discussed the practicality and history of these structures. Around two in the afternoon, we emerged from the canyon, and the town of Danba came into view.
location: G248 National Highway (Bamei to Danba Section), Dadu River Canyon Section, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Arrive at Jiaju Tibetan Village to check in.
description: The vehicle winds its way up the mountain into Jiaju Tibetan Village, where layers of brightly colored Tibetan-style houses come into view. Upon arriving at the pre-booked Jiarong Yili Homestay, the hostess, Zhuoma, warmly helps with the luggage. While checking in at the living room, we savor the butter tea and tsampa brought by Zhuoma, learn how to shape the tsampa, and praise the aroma of the tea, quickly bridging the distance.
location: At the courtyard and living room of the Jia Rong Yi Li Home Homestay in Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

name: Room tidying and contacting relatives and friends
description: After putting down the luggage in the Tibetan-style room, I charged my phone and camera, and wiped my face with a damp towel to relieve driving fatigue. Standing by the window, I admired the scenery of the village and snow-capped mountains, then sent messages and photos to my girlfriend Lin Wei to let her know I had arrived safely and share the joy of reaching my destination.
location: Jiarong Yili Home Homestay Room, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Drive to Zhonglu Tibetan Village
description: After meeting up with the group, drive to Zhonglu Tibetan Village. The journey takes about 15-20 minutes, during which you can admire the distinct layouts and pastoral scenery of the two Tibetan villages along the way.
location: From the Jiarong Yili Home Homestay to the rural road of Zhonglu Tibetan Village, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Visiting the Zhonglu Tibetan Village to Observe the Ancient Watchtowers
description: Hiking through the Zhonglu Tibetan Village, the settlement is ancient and tranquil. We headed to the Kangbo Ancient Watchtower viewing platform to observe up close the stone stacking techniques and shooting holes of the thousand-year-old watchtower, discussing its military defensive functions with Zhang Wei. We encountered an elderly Tibetan man named Dorje, greeted him proactively, and inquired about the age of the watchtower, receiving a friendly response. Zhao Min discussed the topic from the perspective of tourism development, sparking reflections on balancing shop characteristics with commercialization. We stayed for about an hour to take photos.
location: Sichuan Province, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Danba County, Zhonglu Township, Zhonglu Tibetan Village, Kangbo Ancient Watchtower Viewing Platform and Surrounding Areas

name: Return to Jiaju Tibetan Village
description: After concluding the visit to Zhonglu Tibetan Village, we drove back to Jiaju Tibetan Village, with the lingering sunset glow casting a warm halo over the journey.
location: From Zhonglu Tibetan Village to Jiaju Tibetan Village, the rural road in Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Evening Stroll and Photography Creation
description: During the golden hour for photography at Jiaju Tibetan Village, I strolled along the viewing trail with my equipment. The golden glow of the sunset bathed the white Tibetan houses, brown watchtowers, and green fruit trees, creating a play of light and shadow. I focused on composing shots of the watchtower silhouettes, scenes of cooking smoke and daily life, and strings of corn. I also exchanged photography tips with other tourists, showcasing my outgoing and sociable personality.
location: Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, with its viewing trails and public viewing platforms.

name: Return to the homestay for a short rest and social sharing.
description: After returning from a walk, I rested in the homestay's living room, sipping tea while the aroma of dinner wafted from the kitchen. With my companions, I reminisced about the beautiful scenery and sorted through the photos taken in the evening. I shared the satisfactory ones on my social media with the caption "Secret Realm of Western Sichuan," and received likes and comments from friends in Shanghai.
location: Jiarong Yili Home B&B Living Room, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Enjoy a sumptuous Tibetan dinner.
description: Zhuoma prepared a lavish dinner featuring dishes such as clear stewed yak meat, chicken stewed with matsutake mushrooms, cold mixed walnut blossoms, barley cakes, and yogurt. The aroma was irresistible, and under her warm encouragement, the health management plan was completely abandoned, leading to eating much more than usual. The dishes were sincerely praised, and Zhuoma was asked for advice on how to prepare yak meat. The conversation was lively and engaging, successfully carrying out a temporary change in the dietary plan.
location: Jiarong Yili Home Inn Restaurant, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Feeling the tranquility while walking through the village at night after dinner.
description: Feeling full after the meal, they suggested going out for a walk to aid digestion and experience the Tibetan village at night. The three of them strolled along the quiet paths of the village, with no streetlights—only the warm glow from windows and the moonlight. It was incredibly peaceful, with only the sound of footsteps and occasional barks from dogs. While relaxing, they thought about making up for their exercise routine the next day.
location: In the Jiaju Tibetan Village of Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, there is a tranquil path within the village.

name: Starry Night Conversations and In-depth Exchanges
description: On the open-air viewing platform of the homestay, Zhuoma prepared hot tea. The highland night sky was clear, with a brilliant Milky Way stretching across the starry expanse. Wrapped in blankets, we sat in a circle, and the conversation flowed from the stars to childhood memories (sharing amusing stories from the alleyways of Pudong), the meaning of travel, and future plans. Zhao Min discussed the integration of Tibetan culture with commerce, sharing how she drew inspiration for her store displays from the architecture of Tibetan villages. Zhuoma recounted the history of the Tibetan village and her family stories, showing that travel goes beyond merely seeing the scenery.
location: Jiarong Yili Home Homestay Open-air Viewing Platform, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Washing up and winding down the day
description: After returning to the room and freshening up, I imported the photos and videos taken today into the tablet for an initial review and categorization, marking details of the watchtowers, candid shots of people, and stunning sunset scenes as design references. I sent a voice message to my girlfriend, Lin Wei, wishing her goodnight and sharing my thoughts about the starry night conversation. Then, I turned off the lights and rested, concluding a fulfilling day.
location: Jiarong Yili Home Inn Room, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Getting Up and Morning Preparation
description: Waking up in the Jiarong Yili Homestay room at Jiaju Tibetan Village in Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, I freshen up and clear my mind, change into comfortable clothes, check the battery and memory card of my Nikon camera and iPhone, pack my luggage in preparation for leaving in the afternoon, and feel full of anticipation for the final day of the journey.
location: In the Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, inside a room at the Jiarong Yili Home Homestay.

name: Morning Photography Walk and Capturing the Sunrise
description: Walking alone in the Jiaju Tibetan Village, I followed the stone path upward, capturing the morning mist, prayer flags, and the smoke rising from Tibetan houses, documenting the blend of natural and cultural landscapes. At around 07:20, I met my friends Zhang Wei and Zhao Min at the Jiaju Tibetan Village - No. 1 Viewing Platform. Together, we waited and shot time-lapse photography and wide-angle panoramas of the sunrise, perfectly capturing the beauty of the morning mist and sunrise over the Tibetan village.
location: Within Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, and at the No. 1 Viewing Platform of Jiaju Tibetan Village

name: Return to the homestay to tidy up and enjoy a Tibetan-style breakfast.
date: From 07:45:00 on September 20, 2025, to 09:00:00 on September 20, 2025
description: After the shoot, I strolled back to the Jiarong Yili Home B&B with my companions. In the room, I connected my camera and phone to a power bank, wiped the water droplets off the lens, and changed into a casual hoodie and jeans. Later, I joined my friends in the B&B’s dining area to enjoy a hearty Tibetan breakfast prepared by the host, Zhuoma. The meal included butter tea, tsampa, yak meat buns, and yogurt. We learned how to shape tsampa and exchanged travel route ideas.
location: Jiayong Yili Home B&B Rooms and Restaurant, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Deeply Experience the Life and Culture of the Jiarong Tibetans
description: Led by Zhuoma, we delved deep into Jiaju Tibetan Village, where we visited traditional Tibetan houses and learned about the principles behind the thick stone walls, intricately carved wooden window lattices, and the architecture that keeps the interiors warm in winter and cool in summer. We captured detailed photos for reference in the display design of a clothing store. We also visited a local weaver, observing the process of hand-weaving on an ancient loom, exchanged greetings in Tibetan, and purchased a woolen scarf adorned with the Eight Auspicious Symbols (intended as a gift for my girlfriend, Lin Wei) and handmade embroidered sachet ornaments (for decorating the shop). With friends, we discussed ideas for homestay operations, tourism development, and the integration of local culture with commerce, gaining valuable insights.
location: Inside Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province (Zhuoma's Home and Craftsmen's Home)

name: Lunch, packing up, and bidding farewell to the Tibetan village before setting off.
description: Enjoying the last authentic Tibetan-style lunch at the guesthouse restaurant, we returned to our room for a final luggage check, carefully packing souvenirs into the suitcase. At the guesthouse entrance, we took a group photo with Zhuoma's family, sincerely thanking them for their hospitality. Driving the rented SUV with our companions and luggage, we slowly made our way onto the winding village road. In the rearview mirror, the Tibetan houses and watchtowers gradually faded into the distance, filling our hearts with a sense of fulfillment and reflection. The vehicle smoothly merged onto National Highway G248, officially beginning the long journey back to Chengdu.
location: Jiarong Yili Home Homestay and surrounding roads, Jiaju Tibetan Village, Niega Township, Danba County, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province

name: Long-distance driving return to Chengdu
description: Driving an SUV back from Danba to Chengdu, we traveled along the G248 National Highway through the Dadu River Canyon section. The scenery was magnificent but the road was winding, requiring full concentration for about an hour and a half. We briefly stopped at a safe viewing platform to capture the canyon views with our phones. After switching drivers, with Zhang Wei taking the wheel, I organized travel photos on my phone from the passenger seat, creating albums by theme. Zhao Min and I reminisced about the fun moments from the trip, laughing continuously. Upon entering the G4218 Yaye Expressway, we took a break at the Luding Service Area to stretch, buy coffee and snacks, and send messages to our parents and girlfriends via WeChat to let them know we were safe. In the latter half of the journey, Zhao Min and I took turns driving. The road conditions were good, and our conversation shifted to life after returning to Shanghai, including organizing autumn collections for the clothing store, drawing inspiration for displays from the colors of Tibetan villages, discussing plans with our parents to switch to a Nio ES6, and listening to music and business podcasts. The long drive passed with conversation and alternating driving, completing the core process of the long-distance journey.
location: From Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province to Chengdu City in Sichuan Province, National Highway G248, G4218 Ya'an-Yecheng Expressway, and Luding Service Area

name: Arrive in Chengdu and check into the hotel.
description: The vehicle arrived smoothly at the booked Cloudscape Hotel (Longzhaoyan Metro Station Branch), and the check-in process was completed quickly in the lobby. After nearly six hours of driving, everyone looked tired, and you felt soreness in your lower back. Decisively, you canceled any evening exercise plans, aligning with the event setting of postponing exercise due to fatigue. After entering the room, you placed your backpack and camera on the table and let out a long sigh of relief.
location: No. 26 Jinyan Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Lobby and Rooms of Yunjing Hotel (Longzhuaoyan Subway Station Branch)

name: Dinner and Travel Summary
description: Near the hotel, we found a clean and affordable home-style Chinese restaurant (such as Rongcheng Home-style Cuisine) and had dinner with friends. We ordered twice-cooked pork, mapo tofu, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and rice, enjoying the comforting Sichuan flavors that made us feel back in the city. As we ate, we wrapped up our trip to western Sichuan, marveling at how worthwhile the journey had been. We agreed to meet up in Shanghai as soon as possible to share photos and strengthen our friendship.
location: Near Jinyan Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, a local Chinese restaurant

name: Packing luggage and backing up travel documents.
description: Back in the hotel room, I methodically packed my luggage, placing clothes and souvenirs to be checked in the suitcase, while putting the clothes for the next day, camera, and power bank into my carry-on backpack. I backed up all the travel photos and videos from the camera and phone to an external hard drive and iCloud, a process that felt like reliving the wonderful journey.
location: Room inside Yunjing Hotel (Longzhaoyan Subway Station Branch), No. 26 Jinyan Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Wei.
description: After finishing my morning routine, I dialed my girlfriend Lin Wei for a video call, eagerly showing her the woolen scarf I had bought that day. I described the breathtaking sunrise amidst the morning mist and clouds, shared the interesting stories from my conversation with the weaving auntie, and honestly admitted the fatigue from the long drive. On the other end of the screen, Lin Wei listened with a smile, reminding me to rest well on the plane tomorrow. The warm conversation helped wash away some of the weariness.
location: Room inside Yunjing Hotel (Longzhuaoyan Subway Station Branch), No. 26 Jinyan Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Relaxation Before Bed and Preparation for Tomorrow's Return Trip
date: From 21:30:00 on September 20, 2025 to 22:30:00 on September 20, 2025
description: After ending the call, set an alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow (to prepare in advance for the midday flight), check in online and select a seat, and confirm the Didi reservation time from the hotel to Chengdu Shuangliu Airport. Browse the store’s customer group and social media feed to stay updated on Shanghai’s developments. As drowsiness sets in, turn off the lights and fall asleep, recharging for the return to life in Pudong the next day.
location: Room inside Yunjing Hotel (Longzhuayan Subway Station Branch), No. 26 Jinyan Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Morning hotel check-out and breakfast
description: Lei Mingxuan was awakened by the phone alarm, completed washing up and packing his luggage, met with Zhang Wei and Zhao Min in the lobby of the Yun Jing Hotel to check out, and loaded the luggage into the car. Afterwards, he had breakfast at the hotel restaurant, choosing healthy foods such as oatmeal, boiled eggs, yogurt, and fruits, drinking only black coffee, and confirming the day's itinerary with his companions while eating.
location: Yunjing Hotel (Longzhuayan Subway Station Branch), No. 26 Jinyan Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Returning the Vehicle and Related Procedures
description: Lei Mingxuan drove the rented SUV from Yunjing Hotel to a car rental company outlet in Jinjiang District, chatting with Zhang Wei and Zhao Min about their experiences traveling in western Sichuan along the way. Upon arrival, they assisted the staff in inspecting the vehicle. Thanks to their careful driving, the vehicle remained in good condition. They quickly settled the car rental fees, received the settlement slip, and officially concluded the hardware part of their self-drive trip in western Sichuan.
location: Car rental company outlets near Chunxi Road, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Take a taxi to Chunxi Road and store your luggage.
description: The three of them took a taxi from the car rental point to a large shopping mall in the Chunxi Road business district (such as the Guanghua Square), found self-service lockers, and stored all their large luggage to lighten their load for activities in the city.

name: Journey Farewell Lunch
description: At Dian Du De, enjoying Cantonese dim sum served as the official conclusion and farewell to the journey through western Sichuan. Lei Mingxuan raised his cup of tea in place of wine, expressing gratitude to Zhang Wei and Zhao Min for their companionship, trust, and mutual support along the way. They reminisced about the thrilling moments on Zheduo Mountain, the tranquility of the starlit sky over Tibetan villages, and other unforgettable memories, deepening their friendship. Though he had intended to watch his diet, the atmosphere was so delightful that he unknowingly indulged in extra shrimp dumplings and red rice rolls.

description: After lunch, we took a leisurely stroll to Taikoo Li and began our free time in the commercial district. As the owner of a clothing store, Lei Mingxuan’s professional instincts were activated. He wandered through boutiques and designer brand stores, carefully observing the fabrics, cuts, and display methods of the new autumn collections. He paid special attention to the integration of outdoor functionality with urban fashion, drawing connections to his trip to western Sichuan. He captured many detailed photos with his phone for business inspiration. Meanwhile, Zhang Wei and Zhao Min were more interested in trendy cultural and creative products and unique cafes.
location: No. 8, Zhongshamao Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Chengdu Taikoo Li and its surrounding blocks

name: Afternoon Tea and Souvenir Shopping

After entering the waiting area, I took a seat near the boarding gate to rest. Lei Mingxuan sorted out the photos of the shops taken in the afternoon, shared his insights with his cousin Shen Jie for discussion, sent a WeChat message to his girlfriend Lin Wei to let her know he was safe, and then closed his eyes to rest. Zhang Wei and Zhao Min were nearby, quietly reminiscing about the fun moments from their trip.

After the meal, he requested a cup of warm water, put on his noise-canceling headphones and an eye mask, and fell into a deep sleep amid the white noise of the engine, replenishing the exhaustion from days of travel.

After each collected their luggage, they parted ways at the exit of the arrival hall.

After exiting the station, he walked home.

Lei Mingxuan presented them with pastries from Chengdu as gifts, then eagerly took out his phone to share photos and videos of snow-capped mountains, grasslands, and Tibetan villages, recounting stories from his journey. His father inquired in detail about the road and vehicle conditions, while his mother couldn’t stop praising the handmade woolen scarf. The house was filled with laughter and cheerful conversations.

With a helpless smile, I decided to resume exercise and control my diet starting tomorrow. description: After completing the registration at the front desk, Lei Mingxuan efficiently followed the instructions to undergo blood tests, an abdominal ultrasound (with a focus on fatty liver condition), an electrocardiogram, internal and surgical examinations, and a urine test. The medical staff maintained a professional attitude. During the ultrasound, he nervously asked the doctor about the observations, to which the doctor replied, "There should be some improvement compared to last time, but the specifics will be detailed in the report." This provided him with some reassurance. Throughout the check-up, he took the opportunity to reply to a few WeChat inquiries from his store on his phone.

Lei Mingxuan drove away from the medical center and found a familiar "Light Element" salad shop nearby. He ordered an "energy bowl" containing grilled chicken breast, plenty of vegetables, and quinoa, along with a cup of black coffee. While eating, he checked the store surveillance on his phone and saw Xiao Zhang attending to customers, which put him at ease. He then began browsing the trendy toy group messages, eagerly awaiting the delivery. This was part of following the "dietary precautions due to the physical examination."

Lei Mingxuan praised Xiao Zhang and took over the shop. In the afternoon, there were fewer customers, so he used this time to organize a newly arrived batch of winter accessories (scarves, hats) and personally took detailed photos of several new sweaters with his phone, preparing them for online promotion. During this time, he also attended to a casual browsing customer.

While making sales, he occasionally checked his phone for logistics updates, which showed that the trendy toy delivery was "out for delivery," making him increasingly eager with anticipation. At the same time, he was also keeping an eye out for whether Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, would come by.

Inside was a sturdy shockproof box, and upon opening it, the rare hidden edition collectible toy he had longed for and won through multiple draws lay perfectly intact before his eyes. Its design was exquisite, the paintwork meticulous, and under the shop lights, it exuded a remarkable sense of texture. He held it, examining it closely for several minutes, a satisfied smile spreading across his face. This was part of the execution of "signing for and placing the rare hidden edition collectible toy."

In high spirits, he greeted customers with even more enthusiasm.
location: Xuanxuan Clothing Store inside Hangtou Shichen Mall, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Discuss the lease agreement with the property manager.

Zheng Kai brought good news: management had, in principle, agreed to the expansion request. With the report in hand, they began discussing the specifics. Lei Mingxuan proposed expanding into the adjacent shop space to create a more open layout, while Zheng Kai suggested a rental increase based on market research. The two engaged in a practical and friendly negotiation regarding the lease extension and, most crucially, the length of the rent-free period for the new area’s renovation. Some preliminary agreements were reached. Zheng Kai indicated that he would take these details back to draft a more formal proposal. The positive atmosphere of the negotiation filled Lei Mingxuan with confidence about the shop’s upgrade. This was part of executing the plan to "refine the new lease contract framework with Zheng Kai."

location: Xuanxuan Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

His parents were delighted to hear the news. His father reminded him to take care of his health, while his mother was curious about how to use the scanner. Stepping back to admire it, the entire collection cabinet was enhanced by this new "centerpiece." He took out his phone, meticulously captured a few photos with ambient lighting, and posted them in the trendy toy collectors' group with the caption: "Finally, you're here—the centerpiece is in place!" Instantly, he received numerous likes and envious comments. This was part of executing the task of "placing the new collectible in the display cabinet."

description: Brewing a cup of black coffee, Lei Mingxuan sat down at the coffee table in the living room, which temporarily served as his desk. He opened his phone's memo app and several fitness apps, beginning a systematic review of his entire year-long health journey from December 2024 to November 2025. He entered each item one by one: morning runs (from sporadic efforts to a consistent 3–4 times per week, with the app showing a total distance exceeding 800 kilometers), weekend activities (frequency and experiences of basketball, billiards, and hiking), weight changes (from 80 kg at the start of the year to 75.5 kg this morning, successfully bringing his BMI below 25), and dietary adjustments (reducing greasy takeout and increasing protein intake). As he looked at the data and written summaries accumulated day by day through his persistence, a strong sense of pride replaced his fatigue. Based on this solid review, he realized that his "Five-Year Health Plan" was significantly ahead of schedule. It was time to set new goals. After some thought, he wrote down: 1. **Increase Strength Training**: Visit the **Yincheng Road Fitness Center** at least once a week, focusing on chest, back, and legs to improve posture; 2. **Challenge a Half Marathon**: Officially list "completing a half marathon" as a 2026 challenge and start paying attention to Shanghai's first-half-year event information; 3. **Maintain and Optimize**: Keep the current frequency of aerobic exercise and try new outdoor activities like cycling. He recorded these specific, measurable goals in detail and set reminders on his phone.

[Fist bump emoji]"  

Lin Wei quickly replied, "The first 3 seconds need to be more eye-catching! The BGM could be a bit cooler." Qian Duoduo sent a voice message: "Bro Xuan, not bad! You've got the right vibe! Try slowing down the transition shot of the coat by half a second?"

Additionally, I confirmed the down payment amount for the newly purchased elevator apartment, the source of funds (my parents contributed part of their savings, while Lei Mingxuan covered the majority from the shop’s working capital and investments), and that the subsequent monthly mortgage payments would be covered by the shop’s income. My parents expressed their full support.

Zhang Wei sent a bunch of envious emojis.

Lei Mingxuan operated the scanner with a smile, listening to his mother's memories as he saved the digital files into the "Childhood Memories" folder on the computer.

After that, I spent 20 minutes managing the store's community, responding to several inquiries about the pre-sale of new hoodies, and posted a message on my social media feed: "Health is the number 1, and everything else is just zeros. Grateful for persistence—fatty liver is officially gone! Countdown to the Japan trip, looking forward to finding some great items to share! #CheckupPassed #NewYearNewGoals." The post was accompanied by a photo of the exterior of the medical center and an official poster of the anime "Jujutsu Kaisen."

After scanning, the files were backed up to both an external hard drive and a cloud storage service. Later, he had brunch with his parents, Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, who reminded him about travel safety, while Lei Mingxuan shared his excitement about visiting anime pilgrimage sites. Finally, he double-checked his luggage, hugged his parents goodbye, and his mother slipped him some individually wrapped pastries.
