description: Checking my email in the hotel room, I received the electronic certificate for the Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) Barista Skills Foundation certification. Excitedly, I took a screenshot and shared it with my girlfriend Lin Wei, my mom, and our group of friends. After receiving congratulations and follow-up questions, I began thinking about how to apply this certification to my own shop.
location: Room at Akihabara Washington Hotel, 1-15-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, Japan

name: Organize gifts, back up photos, and prepare for returning home the next day.
description: Organize gifts purchased in Japan, categorizing them by intended recipients. Back up photos and videos from the Kamakura trip, selecting satisfactory works. Brew tea while contemplating the application of coffee certification, jotting down initial ideas in a memo, such as setting up a coffee corner, hosting coffee tasting events, and collaborating with local cafes. Afterwards, post a social media update sharing reflections on the last day of the trip, complete online check-in for the flight back to Shanghai the next day, and check the bus schedule from the hotel to Narita Airport.
location: Room at Akihabara Washington Hotel, 1-15-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, Japan

name: Washing up, bedtime reading, and going to bed
description: Perform bedtime hygiene, take a hot shower to relieve fatigue. Lean against the headboard and read the latest chapter of "The Stories of the Ming Dynasty," turn off the lights around 22:45 to rest, ending a fulfilling day with a satisfied mood and anticipation for the return journey.
location: Room at Akihabara Washington Hotel, 1-15-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, Japan

name: Morning Exercise and Stretching
date: From 07:30:00 on December 6, 2025, to 08:15:00 on December 6, 2025
description: The biological clock wakes me up on time. I jog slowly on the treadmill in the hotel gym for 20 minutes, watching the morning light of Tokyo outside the window. Remembering that my weight has reached 77 kilograms, I resolve to exercise more after returning home. Later, I stretch in the small park next to the hotel, breathing in the fresh air.
location: Akihabara Washington Hotel Gym and surrounding streets, Sotokanda, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Japan.

name: Convenience Store Breakfast and Itinerary Planning
description: At LAWSON convenience store, I bought onigiri, milk, and salad for breakfast, quickly ate them while sitting on a high stool by the window. Meanwhile, I used my phone map to plan the route to Ikebukuro, checked information on several target second-hand shops, and noted down that I need to buy a souvenir for my cousin Shen Jie.
location: Lawson Convenience Store near Akihabara Washington Hotel, Sotokanda, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Japan (Specific Address: 1-17-1 Sotokanda)

name: Washing up and pre-departure packing
description: Returning to the room, I took a shower and changed into casual clothes. I started by sorting the small items spread out from last night (badges, keychains) into storage bags, laying the groundwork for the major organizing session in the evening. Then, I checked my passport, wallet, Suica card, and power bank.
location: Akihabara Washington Hotel Room, Sotokanda, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Japan

name: Commuting to Ikebukuro
description: Walk to JR Akihabara Station, tap in with a Suica card, and take the JR Yamanote Line (outer loop) to Ikebukuro Station, which takes about 20 minutes. The Yamanote Line carriage is quite crowded on Saturday morning. With headphones on listening to music, I observe the diverse passengers while planning what treasures to hunt for today.
location: From JR Akihabara Station to Ikebukuro Station

name: Exploring and Shopping for Anime Merchandise in Ikebukuro
description: First, I headed straight to the Animate Ikebukuro main store, meticulously checking each floor for any missing "Jujutsu Kaisen" and "One Piece" merchandise, taking photos for my collector friend Lin Jing in Shanghai. Then, I ventured into a small alley to explore a second-hand model shop called "Ikebukuro Store." After patiently searching, I finally found a well-preserved early HG model of "Gundam" and a cute chibi figure of Zenitsu Agatsuma from "Demon Slayer," leaving me thoroughly satisfied.
location: Ikebukuro, Toshima Ward, Tokyo, Japan: Animate Ikebukuro Main Store (specific address: 1-50-35 Higashi-Ikebukuro) and surrounding small second-hand model shops (e.g., Ikebukuro Store, address: 3-15-2 Higashi-Ikebukuro)

name: Lunch try new ramen shop
description: Feeling hungry after walking around, he decided to try another highly-rated restaurant called "Menya Musashi." After queuing for about 15 minutes, he was seated and ordered the signature Musashi Ramen. The rich fish-based broth and chewy noodles left him thoroughly satisfied, while also sparking thoughts about how to draw inspiration from such unique characteristics to add memorable elements to his own clothing store back home.
location: In the Ikebukuro area of Toshima Ward, Tokyo, Japan, there is a ramen shop named "Menya Musashi Ikebukuro Branch" (specific address: 1-16-12 Minami-Ikebukuro).

name: Cat Cafe Leisure and Coffee Exchange
description: Wanting to relax after a meal, I chose a cat café where you can pet cats. After paying for an hour, I ordered a latte with a cat paw latte art, sat in a beanbag chair, and flipped through a Japanese fashion magazine. As a new barista, I paid special attention to the coffee presentation and latte art techniques, and chatted with a staff member who spoke basic English about coffee beans.
location: In the Nishi-Ikebukuro area of Toshima Ward, Tokyo, Japan, there is a cat café named "Cat MOCHA Ikebukuro Branch" (specific address: 1-15-6 Nishi-Ikebukuro, Meitoku 7F).

name: Video conferencing with parents to discuss car purchase plans.
description: Connect to the café's Wi-Fi and have a video call with parents at home in Shanghai. The parents show information and quotes for the test-driven BYD SUV and Toyota RAV4 hybrid. Considering a budget of 250,000 to 300,000 yuan, they focus on inquiring about the vehicle's range, maintenance costs, and potential cash flow conflicts with the down payment for another property. After discussion, it is decided that he will personally test drive and finalize the decision after returning to China (within next week). Until then, the parents will stay in touch with the salesperson but will not pay any deposit.
location: In the relatively quiet corner of Cat MOCHA Ikebukuro store, Nishi-Ikebukuro, Toshima Ward, Tokyo, Japan.

name: Purchase souvenirs and return to the hotel.
description: The video ended, and I remembered that I hadn't bought the gift for my cousin Shen Jie. Leaving the café, I walked to Ikebukuro Station. Considering that carrying a model would be inconvenient for a long walk, I chose to take the Marunouchi Line subway to Ochanomizu Station, where I transferred to the JR Chuo Line (Rapid) to Akihabara Station. At the "Tokyo Banana" specialty store near Akihabara Station, I bought a box of limited-edition banana cakes.
location: From Ikebukuro Station to Akihabara Station, and near Akihabara Station, the "Tokyo Banana" specialty store (specific address: 1-9-5 Sotokanda)

name: Packing and Organizing Belongings
description: Back in the room, I began the "big project." I spread out all the items purchased over the past nine days: figurines, models, anime merchandise, gifts, and clothing. Using my own soft clothes, I carefully wrapped the fragile items and securely placed them in the middle layer of the suitcase. Gifts for my parents and friends were set aside separately. The organizing process took nearly two hours, and looking at the neatly arranged suitcase filled me with a sense of accomplishment.
location: Akihabara Washington Hotel Room, Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, Japan

name: Farewell Dinner Enjoying Standing Sushi
description: For dinner, I chose a standing sushi restaurant that locals frequent, known for its great value. Standing at the counter, I ordered a set of ten pieces, including fatty tuna and sea urchin. Watching the chef’s skilled techniques and savoring the fresh ingredients, my thoughts drifted: from the excitement of Akihabara to the tranquility of Kamakura, and then to the remote discussions with my parents. This trip was a collection of inspirations, and I began to contemplate how to incorporate anime and coffee elements into my own clothing store.
location: Near Akihabara Station in Sotokanda, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Japan, there is a standing sushi restaurant named "Tachigui Sushi Nemuro Hanamaru Akihabara Store" (specific address: 1-3-1 Sotokanda).

name: Nighttime Strolls and Convenient Shopping
description: After dinner, I took a final stroll under the neon lights of Akihabara. Passing by a FamilyMart that was still open, I went in to buy bottled water for tomorrow morning at the airport and a bento as a backup.
location: The streets around Akihabara Station, and finally at the FamilyMart convenience store near the hotel (specific address: 1-17-3 Sotokanda).

name: Final Confirmation of Luggage and Departure Preparation
description: Returning to the hotel, I made a final check to ensure the suitcase was locked and its weight was within the limit. I prepared the clothes to wear tomorrow and the backpack to carry. I confirmed and saved a screenshot of the electronic ticket for the Narita Express (N'EX) train to Narita Airport (departure time: 09:44). I charged my phone and power bank.
location: Akihabara Washington Hotel Room, Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, Japan

name: Washing, Leisure, and Bedtime Review
description: A hot shower washes away the fatigue. Lying in bed, I scroll through my phone’s photo album, reliving the highlights of the nine-day trip. I pick a few favorite photos and post them on my social media feed with the caption: “Tokyo trip wrapped up, returning with a full load (and not just the luggage). Looking forward to being back in Shanghai—new ideas ready to take shape!” Likes and comments come in from Gao Yuan, Lin Jing, my girlfriend Lin Wei, and others. I set the alarm and turn off the lights before 11:00 p.m.
location: Akihabara Washington Hotel Room, Sotokanda, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Japan

name: Wake up in the morning and check out of the hotel.
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up at the Washington Hotel in Akihabara, Tokyo, feeling soreness in his calf muscles and performed some stretching exercises. After washing up, he packed his luggage, double-checked to ensure nothing was left behind, then went downstairs to check out, bidding farewell in both Japanese and English.
location: Akihabara Washington Hotel, Sotokanda, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Japan - Rooms and Front Desk

name: Convenience store breakfast and heading to Akihabara Station
date: From 08:30:00 on December 7, 2025, to 09:00:00 on December 7, 2025
description: Lei Mingxuan bought a tuna rice ball and a hot latte for breakfast at LAWSON convenience store, quickly finishing them outside the store. He then walked about 7 minutes to JR Akihabara Station to catch the N'EX train.
location: Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, Outer Kanda, streets around Akihabara Station and LAWSON convenience store

name: Take the Narita Express to the airport.
description: Lei Mingxuan boarded the N'EX train departing at 09:44, connected to Wi-Fi to check the flight status, scrolled through WeChat to see friends' updates, and watched the scenery outside the window to bid farewell to Tokyo.
location: JR East Japan N'EX Narita Express (from Akihabara Station to Narita Airport Terminal 1 Station) inside the train carriage

name: Narita Airport Check-in Procedures and Duty-Free Shopping
description: Upon arriving at Narita Airport, Lei Mingxuan checked in and checked his luggage, then proceeded to the customs tax refund counter to handle the tax refund. After passing through security, he shopped for gifts in the duty-free area, including Shiseido skincare products and cigarettes for his parents, as well as snacks such as Royce raw chocolate for his friends.
location: Narita International Airport Terminal 1, Narita City, Chiba Prefecture, Japan: China Southern Airlines counter, customs tax refund office, duty-free area.

name: Board the aircraft and prepare for takeoff.
description: Lei Mingxuan began boarding the plane, found a window seat, placed his luggage, and asked the flight attendant for a blanket and water. The plane taxied and took off, and he enjoyed the in-flight lunch (Japanese set meal).
location: Narita International Airport Terminal 1, Gate XX, Cabin of Flight CZXXXX

name: Rest and Planning During Long-Haul Flights
description: Lei Mingxuan caught about 1.5 hours of sleep during the flight. After waking up, he sorted through his travel photos and selected nine to post on his social media feed. At the same time, he planned his to-do list for after returning home in his memo, including taking stock of inventory, contacting suppliers, arranging test drives, and organizing receipts for smart home devices.
location: Inside the cabin of flight CZXXXX (Tokyo Narita to Shanghai Pudong)

name: Arrive at Pudong Airport and complete immigration procedures.
description: The plane landed at Shanghai Pudong Airport. Lei Mingxuan turned on his phone to connect to the internet and checked his WeChat messages. After completing the entry procedures, he retrieved his checked luggage at the baggage claim area, soaking in the familiar atmosphere of being back in Shanghai.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Shanghai Pudong International Airport Terminal 2 Arrival Hall, Baggage Claim Area

name: Taking a taxi from the airport back home.
description: Lei Mingxuan hailed a ride through Didi, and the driver helped him with his luggage. Stuck in traffic, he admired the night view of Pudong and sent a voice message to his mother, informing her of his estimated time of arrival.
location: Shanghai Pudong International Airport Terminal 2, Pudong New District, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area (en route)

name: Arriving home to reunite with parents and prepare dinner.
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at his home in Shanggang Community, where his father was downstairs helping to move the luggage. After entering the house, he hugged his mother and presented gifts he had brought from Japan. His mother was preparing dinner in the kitchen, and Lei Mingxuan was asked to rest and chat with his father, sharing stories from his travels.
location: At Home (Living Room, Kitchen) in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Family dinner time
description: Lei Mingxuan had dinner with his parents, enjoying dishes such as braised pork and stir-fried shrimp. With a hearty appetite, he shared amusing stories from his travels, including visits to cat cafes and experiences in Kamakura. His parents inquired about his barista certification and the inspiration behind his shop.
location: Home Restaurant, Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Unboxing and arranging travel souvenirs
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan opened his suitcase in the living room and showed his parents the anime models and figurines he had purchased, such as HG Gundam and "Demon Slayer" collectibles, explaining their value as collectibles. He then placed the precious items in the display cabinet in the study and sorted the snacks on the coffee table.
location: Shanghai Pudong New District, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, living room and study at home.

name: Social interaction to report safety and share travel experiences.
description: Lei Mingxuan sent a message to his friend Gao Yuan to report that he was safe and to show off his collection; he posted nine travel photos on his social media feed, receiving likes and comments from friends; he shared details about his figurines in a trendy toys WeChat group, engaging in discussions with fellow enthusiasts.
location: In the study room of Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Discuss family finances with parents.
description: Lei Mingxuan was having tea with his parents in the living room, discussing family finances. He presented the shop's transaction records and mentioned the receipts for smart home devices purchased in Japan. His parents checked the rental income and investment situation, talked about year-end expenses and next year's car purchase budget, and agreed to conduct a detailed review next week.
location: In the living room of Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Evening Life Organization and Relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan does a 15-minute full-body stretch in the bedroom to relieve fatigue, then checks the refrigerator and finds that there is not enough milk and fruit, so he updates the shopping list. He prepares the clothes to wear to the store tomorrow.
location: Shanghai City, Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, bedroom and kitchen at home

name: Washing and Pre-sleep Activities
description: Lei Mingxuan relaxed with a bath, browsed Bilibili and Taobao in bed, and sent messages in the store's VIP group to announce upcoming business. After turning off the lights, he reflected on the day and fell asleep with a sense of accomplishment.
location: Shanghai City, Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, bedroom and bathroom in the home

name: Morning Family Routine
date: From 07:40:00 on December 8, 2025, to 08:45:00 on December 8, 2025
description: Woken by the alarm, I canceled my morning run due to the overcast and rainy weather, opting instead for some simple stretches in the living room to ease the fatigue from the journey. Later, I had breakfast with my parents. My mother prepared hot porridge, pickles, and fried eggs, while my father expressed concern about the backlog of tasks at the shop. My mother reminded me to drive carefully in the rain and shared her satisfaction with arranging the figurines brought back from Japan. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: At home in Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
date: From 08:45:00 on December 8, 2025 to 09:20:00 on December 8, 2025
description: Putting on a thick coat, I drove from home, passing through the central ring road and turning onto Hunan Road to head toward Hangtou Shichen Mall. It was the tail end of the morning rush hour, and the car was playing music from "Jujutsu Kaisen" to boost my spirits. The entire journey took about 35 minutes.
location: Underground Parking Lot, Shichen Shopping Mall, No. 888 Hanghe Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New District

name: Store Resumption and New Product Preheating
description: Upon arriving at the store, I listened to the part-time employee Xiao Chen’s briefing on the day’s operations and pending orders. I personally swept the floor, wiped the shelves, and organized the displays to restore the store’s clean and bright appearance. Afterward, I adorned the cashier counter and clothing racks with anime-themed trinkets brought back from Japan. I then took photos of the store’s atmosphere, edited the captions, and posted them on my social media circle and regular customer groups to promote the new items. I also interacted and responded to customers such as Qian Duoduo and Zhao Min.
location: "Xuan Chao" Clothing Store, inside Shichen Mall, No. 888 Hanghe Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New District

name: Shopping Mall Lunch Break
description: At the Subway in the food court on B1 of Shichen Mall, I bought a sandwich and coffee. While eating, I scrolled through my phone to reply to work messages and browse industry-related public accounts. After the meal, I sat in the shop for a while, letting my mind wander as I watched the rainy scene outside the window.
location: Subway, Food Court, B1 Floor, Shichen Mall, No. 888 Hanghe Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New District

name: Handling Backlog Orders and Customer Reception
description: Returned to the store to handle the backlog of online orders, packaging and shipping them. During this time, I attended to several in-store customers, multitasking by packaging while greeting them. I recommended a jacket and matching innerwear to a regular customer and successfully made the sale.
location: "Xuanchao" Clothing Store, inside Shichen Shopping Mall, No. 888 Hanghe Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New District

name: Tax Organization Online Consultation
description: In the store, I consulted financial advisor Xu Feng via WeChat about the tax treatment of invoices for smart home devices for the new house. Xu Feng provided professional advice, and then I created a new dedicated folder on the computer to start archiving.
location: "Xuanchao" Clothing Store, inside Shichen Mall, No. 888 Hanghe Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New District

name: Outbound Parcel Pickup and Daily Shopping Trip
description: Starting from the shop, take Metro Line 18 and transfer to Line 2 to reach the Old Shanghai Image Restoration Studio at No. 556 Fuzhou Road, Huangpu District. Retrieve the beautifully restored and framed family portrait of my ancestors, and after careful inspection, I am very satisfied. On the way, I stop by an independent café on Jiangxi Middle Road, order a pour-over coffee, admire the old photos, and observe the shop's interior design. Then, I take a taxi back to Pudong, purchase milk, fruits, and frozen foods to restock at the Ru Hai Wholesale Department at No. 36 Laoshan Road, and finally drive home. The entire trip covers picking up items, leisure, shopping, and commuting.
location: No. 556 Fuzhou Road, Huangpu District, Old Shanghai Image Restoration Studio

name: Family Dinner and the Finalization of Photo Album Digitization
description: Having dinner with my parents, my mother made braised pork ribs and hot soup to ward off the cold. We looked at the restored old photos, and my parents happily reminisced about the past. After the meal, I used a home scanner in the study to scan the old photos in high definition, renamed the files, and saved them in the "Family Digital Album - Ancestors" folder. This completed the main part of the family memory project, leaving me with a great sense of accomplishment.
location: At home in Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Discuss new orders with suppliers over the phone.
description: In the study, I had a phone discussion with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao about the new season's fabric trends, popular colors, and preliminary pattern selections. Combining insights from the characteristics of our store's customer base and observations from my trip to Japan, I offered suggestions. Zhou Tao shared updates on the Hangzhou market, and we agreed to finalize order details next week. After the call, I noted down the key points.
location: In the study room of Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Personal Leisure and Relaxation
description: After continuous work, I switch gears by taking out the Gundam model I brought back from Japan from the display cabinet, playing with it and admiring its details. Then, I turn on the stereo to play the anime soundtrack, leaning back on the sofa to relax with my eyes closed.
location: In the living room of Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Stock Investment Mindset Adjustment and Review
description: Opening the stock app to check market fluctuations, but recalling the conversation with the financial advisor brings a sense of calm. Deciding to avoid frequent trading, I will treat it as part of a long-term asset allocation strategy. My focus now returns to managing the shop, and I simply record the current holdings.
location: In the study room at Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Organize the annual sales data of the store.
description: Faced with a messy Excel spreadsheet of annual sales data, I began the sorting process by first separating the data into monthly sheets. Then, I performed preliminary classification and pasting of the raw data based on "online/offline" and "product category" to establish a clear framework. Throughout the process, I felt pressure, but the progress was acceptable.
location: In the study room at Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Pre-sleep Preparation and Reading
description: After finishing work, I washed up and lay in bed reading "The Ming Dynasty Stories." In my phone's memo, I listed tomorrow's priorities: follow up on pending orders, continue organizing data, and contact Zheng Kai from the mall property management. I turned off the lights, reflected on the day, and drifted off to sleep amid the sound of rain and a sense of exhaustion.
location: In the bedroom of Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Morning Home Activities and Breakfast
date: From 07:30:00 on December 9, 2025, to 08:45:00 on December 9, 2025
description: Waking up to the sound of the chilly north wind, I canceled my planned morning run. After washing up, I had breakfast with my parents in the dining room. My mother prepared hot porridge, fried eggs, and steamed buns, while my father watched the morning news. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan briefly mentioned that he needed to confirm the loan with the bank and arrange for a moving company today. My parents reminded him to carefully review the terms. After breakfast, I did some simple stretches in my room to relax my shoulders and neck, and organized my personal items (such as anime figurines and chargers), attaching sticky notes to prepare for packing in the evening.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai (Shanggang Residential Area)

name: Drive to the store
date: From 08:45:00 on December 9, 2025 to 09:20:00 on December 9, 2025
description: Putting on a thick coat, grabbing the car keys and the commuter bag, I head out to retrieve the car from the underground garage. I drive my private vehicle along Pudong Avenue, Luoshan Road, and Hunan Highway to Hangtou Shichen Mall. The Tuesday morning rush hour has passed, and the traffic flows smoothly, taking about 35 minutes. Along the way, I play a collection of anime theme songs via the car's Bluetooth to stay refreshed.
location: No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Hangtou Shichen Mall

name: Store Opening Preparation and Daily Operations
description: Upon arriving at the store, open the door and turn on the lights, then inspect the condition of the shop. Perform daily cleaning tasks, including wiping down shelves and the checkout counter, and tidying up clothes that were tried on by customers yesterday but not returned to their proper places. Adjust the display positions of autumn and winter coats based on the weather and sales performance, placing them in more prominent locations. Finally, use your phone to post pictures and descriptions of today’s featured fleece-lined hoodies and thick coats on WeChat Moments and in regular customer groups.
location: "Xuan Xuan" Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Final Confirmation of New Home Loan
description: In the small compartment behind the shop's cashier counter, contact the bank account manager via WeChat to finalize the details of the loan agreement, such as the rules for early repayment and conditions for interest rate adjustments. The account manager sends the revised electronic version of the contract, and Lei Mingxuan carefully reviews the key pages on both his phone and computer. After confirming everything is correct, he completes the confirmation with an electronic signature and receives a message stating, "The expected loan disbursement date is December 11."
location: "Xuanxuan" Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Shopping Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Confirm the moving company and make an appointment.
description: Using a mobile app and WeChat recommendations, compare the quotes, service details, and user reviews of three moving companies, and select one with better ratings. Communicate with the customer service via phone to confirm the moving address, time (9:00 AM on December 12), and item list (emphasizing fragile items and display cabinets), then complete the online reservation and pay the deposit. Pin the confirmation SMS and the customer service WeChat contact for easy access.
location: "Xuanxuan" Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: The store operates and serves customers in the morning.
description: After handling important matters, I returned to the front desk area of the store to attend to customers. As foot traffic in the mall increased, I proactively offered styling suggestions and successfully sold a fleece-lined hoodie and a pair of jeans. During this time, a regular customer, Qian Duoduo, inquired about the stock of a particular jacket via WeChat. I promptly checked the inventory and responded.
location: "Xuanxuan" Clothing Store, located inside Hangtou Shichen Mall at No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and Brief Socializing
description: Closed for lunch break, I met up with my university classmate Zhao Min at a Japanese ramen shop in the mall. Lei Mingxuan ordered the signature tonkotsu ramen, while Zhao Min went for the spicy miso ramen. As we ate and chatted, Lei Mingxuan shared about the busyness and anticipation of moving, and Zhao Min talked about a recent market event she had been planning. She mentioned a Chinese-style designer brand that might fit the shop’s vibe and promised to share the WeChat contact later. This simple meal served as both a social break and an opportunity to gather potential business information.
location: "Jinyan Road Ramen Shop" inside Hangtou Shichen Shopping Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Return to the store and prepare for the afternoon.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Min, I first went to the "Zhengda Wudaokou Square Convenience Store" on the first floor of the mall to buy a bottle of sugar-free oolong tea and a fruit cut box to replenish my energy. Returning to the shop, I tidied up briefly, played some light background music, and prepared to welcome the afternoon flow of customers.
location: "Xuanxuan" Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Shopping Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon Business and Sales Data Organization
description: In the afternoon, the customer flow was relatively steady. During the intervals between serving customers and completing sales, I continued organizing the annual sales data using the cash register computer. I completed the data entry and preliminary classification for the third quarter (July–September), compared the sales trends of summer and early autumn clothing, and highlighted several standout individual styles with high sales. This groundwork will support tomorrow’s summary analysis.
location: "Xuanxuan" Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Research on Chinese Trendy Brands and Independent Designers
description: Utilize relatively idle time to search for Chinese trendy brands and independent designers mentioned by Zhao Min or of personal interest on computers and mobile devices. Browse official stores, social media platforms, and buyer shop reviews to gain a preliminary understanding of design styles, price ranges, and collaboration models. Save and organize useful webpages and designer information as preliminary material for future animation collaboration plans.
location: "Xuanxuan" Clothing Store, inside Hangtou Shichen Mall, No. 170 Hangtou Road, Hangtou Town, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store Closing Procedures and Settlement
description: As closing time approaches, the flow of customers in the mall decreases. Pre-closure tasks include tidying up the fitting rooms, organizing the shelves, settling the day's sales, and reconciling accounts from WeChat, Alipay, and cash payments. Any follow-up tasks for the next day, such as notifying customers about pre-ordered sizes that have arrived, are recorded in the phone's memo app. Finally, the lights and power are turned off, and the store is locked before leaving.
